# derived from Linux /proc semantics and DESIGN.md §7.1, not captured from a run
# Expectation for `ports_owned` against input/. See tests/fixtures/doctor/ports_owned/expect.json for
# the /proc/net/tcp column traps and the dangling-symlink note.
#
# THIS CASE IS THE ONLY `fail` ports_owned HAS. §7.1: "fail when ANYTHING is bound to a non-loopback
# address" -- anything, including our own unit. input/proc/net/tcp's single row is
#   0: 00000000:46A1 ... 0A ... 8801
# i.e. 18081 (0x46A1) LISTENING on 0.0.0.0 (00000000), inode 8801 -> pid 41233, which IS
# fmonero-monerod.service's MainPID in the systemctl fixture. So ownership is ours and the verdict is
# still `fail`: who owns it does not matter, where it is bound does.
# WHY THAT IS THE SEVERE CASE AND NOT A COSMETIC ONE (§2c): a loopback-bound RPC port is already
# reachable by any web page the user visits, via fetch("http://127.0.0.1:18081/json_rpc"), which is why
# both units carry a Digest credential -- an unauthenticated POST gets a 401 and the handler never
# runs, and a sweep_all does not need a readable reply. A port on 0.0.0.0 removes the one remaining
# barrier, the network boundary, and exposes the same surface to the LAN.
# THE argv NAMES THE CAUSE: --rpc-bind-ip 0.0.0.0 --confirm-external-bind. monerod REFUSES a
# non-loopback bind without that second flag (src/rpc/rpc_args.cpp:92, :99), so its presence means
# somebody asked for this deliberately -- by hand-editing the unit, since `fmonero setup --units`
# never writes either flag, and the doctor's own unit_loopback check (class B, fixable) is what
# rewrites it back.
# TWO CHECKS SEE THIS MACHINE, AND THEY ARE NOT REDUNDANT: unit_loopback reads the UNIT FILE (what was
# configured) and ports_owned reads /proc/net/tcp (what is actually bound). A hand-started monerod, or
# a unit edited after it started, makes them disagree -- which is the whole reason §7.1 has both.
# `fixable` false, class D: killing or rebinding a running daemon is not the doctor's business (§7).
# THE DETAIL MUST NAME THE PID AND THE BIND ADDRESS, per §7.1's fix column for this row.
